messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Change in the  DIC value for the same model with different runs
parts:
it run into problems in the optimisation and the main matrix is
numerically singular. I would try to tighten up the model more, like
doing

control.fixed=list(prec.intercept=1, prec=1)

and for safety adding

control.inla=list(cmin=0)

If that does not work, send me code and data to rerun here
